name: zorux
description: AI-first web framework: API, Web, Mobile — minimal tokens, maximum output

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:css && bun run postbuild
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const{cpSync,existsSync,mkdirSync,readdirSync,rmSync}=require('fs');const{join}=require('path');const fs=require('fs');const s=join(__dirname,'dist/index.js');fs.writeFileSync(s,'#!/usr/bin/env bun\n'+fs.readFileSync(s,'utf-8'));const src=join(__dirname,'src/views/static');const dst=join(__dirname,'dist/views/static');if(existsSync(src)){mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of readdirSync(src)){if(f==='admin.css')continue;const sp=join(src,f);const dp=join(dst,f);fs.cpSync(sp,dp,{recursive:true,force:true})}}"
